turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi, this is Jamie calling from Maple Bank. This call may be recorded for quality and training purposes.

turns.text: Speaking.

turns.speaker: customer

turns.speaker: agent

turns.text: Give me a second while I open your file.

turns.text: Sure.

turns.text: Why was I charged a late fee? I paid on time in the app.

turns.text: I understand. I'll note that on the file and have it reviewed.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'm sorry to hear that. We have hardship options, like a reduced payment for three months. Would you like me to review that with you?

turns.text: Yes, that would help.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'll make a on the file so hardship team can review your situation.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, thank you.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: You should hear from them within a few business days.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I'll try to pay 500 Oct 16.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Just to confirm, a payment of $500.00 on October 16. I'll send you a payment link.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: How would you like to make that payment?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Online banking is easiest.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: That works.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Is there anything else I can help you with today?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for your time today. You'll receive a confirmation by text. Have a good evening.
